name: Spinach Dip
description: A creamy spinach dip made with sour cream, mayonnaise, and Knorr vegetable soup mix, served in a hollowed-out pumpernickel bread loaf.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained
1 can (10 oz) water chestnuts, drained and chopped

recipeInstructions.text: Squeeze excess moisture from the thawed spinach.
In a bowl, combine the spinach, sour cream, mayonnaise, Knorr soup mix, water chestnuts, and green onions. Stir until well combined.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend.
If using a bread loaf, scoop out a large hollow through the top and fill with the dip mixture. Serve with bread cubes cut from the centre and/or assorted fresh vegetables.

keywords: spinach dip, party appetizer, pumpernickel bread

_similar.name: Cheese Dip in a Bread Bowl
_similar.description: A warm cheese and ham dip served in a hollowed-out bread loaf.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the bread loaf and hollow out most of the soft bread inside.
Mix together the cream cheese, sour cream, ham, green pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, Tabasco sauce, and Worcestershire sauce.
Fill the hollowed bread loaf with the cheese mixture and replace the lid.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 1 hour.
Serve hot with the reserved bread chunks and fresh veggies for dipping.

_similar.keywords: bread bowl dip, ham and cheese dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Surprise Spread
_similar.description: A layered seafood dip with shrimp, cocktail sauce, and cheese.
recipeIngredient: 3 (4 oz) cans small shrimp, rinsed and drained
Tortilla chips or assorted crackers for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Spread this mixture in the bottom of a deep pie plate, pizza pan, or shallow baking dish.
Scatter the shrimp over the top.
Cover with the seafood cocktail sauce.
Add layers of mozzarella cheese, green pepper, and green onions.
Top with diced tomatoes if desired.
Chill until ready to serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

_similar.keywords: layered shrimp dip, seafood spread, party dip

_similar.name: Hot Cheese Dip
_similar.description: A creamy bacon and cheddar dip baked inside a pumpernickel bread shell.

recipeInstructions.text: Cut the top off the pumpernickel loaf and hollow it out, leaving a thick shell.
Mix the cream cheese, mayonnaise, cheddar cheese, and bacon bits until well combined.
Spoon the mixture into the hollowed-out bread.
Wrap the loaf in tinfoil, leaving the hole with the cheese mixture uncovered.
Bake at 325°F for 1½ hours.
Serve hot with the bread pieces.

_similar.keywords: pumpernickel dip, hot bacon dip, cheddar dip

_similar.name: Shrimp Spread
_similar.description: A savory shrimp and cheddar cheese spread served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl.
Mash the shrimp with a fork until well blended.
Refrigerate before serving with crackers.

_similar.keywords: shrimp spread, seafood dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Artichoke Appetizer
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy artichoke appetizer perfect for serving with bread or crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain artichoke hearts.
Combine artichoke hearts with cheese, mayonnaise, garlic salt, and green onion in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle parsley over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with bread or crackers.

_similar.keywords: artichoke appetizer, cheesy dip, party snack
